result.description: The Lunara Prism 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for illustration, office dashboards, and color-conscious everyday work. It features a 2560 x 1440 QHD IPS panel, slim bezels, and adjustable tilt and height support for comfortable multi-hour use. Built for general-purpose productivity rather than gaming or professional graphics acceleration, it emphasizes crisp text, wide viewing angles, and a clean matte finish.
